title: Add built-in response compression middleware
description: Introduce a middleware that automatically compresses HTTP responses using gzip when the payload exceeds a configurable size and the client supports it. This reduces bandwidth usage and improves load times without adding external dependencies.
testCases: Compresses response when payload > threshold and client Accept-Encoding includes gzip
Does not compress when payload <= threshold
Falls back gracefully when client does not support gzip
acceptance: The compression middleware can be enabled via app.use(compression({threshold: 1024})), correctly sets Content‑Encoding header, streams compressed data, respects client Accept‑Encoding, and does not alter non‑compressible responses. All existing tests pass and new compression tests pass.
reason: Reducing response size directly improves user experience and server cost, addressing a common performance bottleneck while keeping the framework lightweight and dependency‑free.
